title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Why can’t a Super User create a new Company
summary: The post explains why users with the SUPER permission set cannot create a new company in Business Central. When a specific company is designated in the SUPER permission set assignment, the user's rights become restricted to only that company, preventing them from creating new companies across the system.
key_points: Only users with the SUPER permission set can create a new company in Business Central
When a specific company is designated during permission set assignment, access is limited to that company only
If no company is specified when assigning a permission set, it applies to all companies
Users cannot remove a company designation from their own permissions; only administrators with SUPER or SECURITY permission sets can modify this
This company restriction principle applies to all permission sets, not just SUPER
